   - \( s_{98} = 7^{s_{97}} \).

By induction, we can show that for all \( n \geq 2 \), \( s_n \equiv 3 \mod 5 \). Thus, the remainder when \( s_{100} \) is divided by 5 is \(\boxed{3}\).
